quiz.0.question: Approximately how much tannin does Sagrantino contain?
quiz.0.explanation: Sagrantino di Montefalco has the highest tannin content of any grape in the world — around 3,000–3,500 mg/L — far exceeding Nebbiolo or Cabernet.
quiz.1.question: How is Sagrantino di Montefalco Passito made?
quiz.1.explanation: The Passito style of Sagrantino is made by drying the grapes to concentrate their sugar, then fermenting to produce a rich, complex sweet red wine.
quiz.2.question: What is the dominant variety of Orvieto DOC?
quiz.2.explanation: Orvieto DOC is based on Grechetto (minimum 40–60%), supported by Trebbiano Toscano and Verdello, producing a fresh and mineral white wine.
quiz.3.question: What is the main difference between Montefalco Rosso and Sagrantino di Montefalco?
quiz.3.options.0: They are made in different regions
quiz.3.options.1: Montefalco Rosso uses a Sangiovese-based blend; Sagrantino is 100% Sagrantino
quiz.3.options.2: Montefalco Rosso is a white wine
quiz.3.options.3: Sagrantino is only produced as a sweet wine
quiz.3.explanation: Montefalco Rosso uses a blend led by Sangiovese (60–70%) with Sagrantino (10–15%) and is more approachable. Sagrantino di Montefalco DOCG requires 100% Sagrantino.
